### `EqualProductDefinitions.lean`

```lean
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Multiset.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

namespace EqualProduct

/-- An n-partition of s: a multiset of n positive integers with sum s. -/
def IsPartition (n s : ℕ) (X : Multiset ℕ) : Prop :=
  Multiset.card X = n ∧ (∀ x ∈ X, 0 < x) ∧ X.sum = s

/-- At least r different n-partitions of s sharing one product. -/
def Good (r n s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∃ p : ℕ, ∃ F : Finset (Multiset ℕ), r ≤ F.card ∧
    ∀ X ∈ F, IsPartition n s X ∧ X.prod = p

def IsTail (r n h : ℕ) : Prop := 0 < h ∧ ∀ s, h ≤ s → Good r n s

/-- h is the least positive permanent-tail threshold s*_r(n). -/
def IsSStar (r n h : ℕ) : Prop :=
  IsTail r n h ∧ ∀ h', IsTail r n h' → h ≤ h'

theorem sStar_unique {r n h h' : ℕ} (h₁ : IsSStar r n h)
    (h₂ : IsSStar r n h') : h = h' :=
  Nat.le_antisymm (h₁.2 h' h₂.1) (h₂.2 h h₁.1)

#print axioms sStar_unique
end EqualProduct
```

```lean
import EqualProductDefinitions
import Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Sort
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Image
import Mathlib.Data.List.Range

set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false
namespace EqualProduct

/-- Canonical sorted lists of d positive parts, with a lower bound b. -/
def partitionEnum : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List (List ℕ)
  | 0, s, _ => if s = 0 then [[]] else []
  | d+1, s, b => (List.range' b (s/(d+1)+1-b)).flatMap fun a =>
      (partitionEnum d (s-a) a).map (List.cons a)

theorem list_card_mul_le_sum (L : List ℕ) (b : ℕ)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ L, b ≤ x) : L.length*b ≤ L.sum := by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a L ih =>
    have ha := hb a (by simp)
    have ht := ih (fun x hx => hb x (by simp [hx]))
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.sum_cons, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

theorem partitionEnum_complete {d s b : ℕ} {L : List ℕ}
    (hlen : L.length = d) (hsum : L.sum = s)
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ L, b ≤ x) (hord : L.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) :
    L ∈ partitionEnum d s b := by
  induction d generalizing L s b with
  | zero =>
    have he : L = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp hlen
    subst L
    simp only [List.sum_nil] at hsum
    subst s
    simp [partitionEnum]
  | succ d ih =>
    cases L with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons a L =>
      have hlen' : L.length = d := by simpa using hlen
      have hsum' : L.sum = s-a := by simp only [List.sum_cons] at hsum; omega
      have hhead : b ≤ a := hb a (by simp)
      have hrest : ∀ x ∈ L, a ≤ x := (List.pairwise_cons.mp hord).1
      have htail := ih hlen' hsum' hrest (List.pairwise_cons.mp hord).2
      have ha : a ≤ s/(d+1) := by
        apply (Nat.le_div_iff_mul_le (by omega)).mpr
        have hbound := list_card_mul_le_sum (a::L) a (by
          intro x hx
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with hx | hx
          · omega
          · exact hrest x hx)
        rw [hlen, hsum] at hbound
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using hbound
      simp only [partitionEnum, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_range'_1, List.mem_map]
      exact ⟨a, ⟨hhead, by omega⟩, L, htail, rfl⟩

/-- Every literal source partition is represented by the canonical finite enumeration. -/
theorem partitionEnum_complete_multiset {d s : ℕ} {X : Multiset ℕ}
    (hX : IsPartition d s X) :
    X ∈ (partitionEnum d s 1).map (fun L : List ℕ => (L : Multiset ℕ)) := by
  have he := Multiset.sort_eq X (· ≤ ·)
  have hm : X.sort (· ≤ ·) ∈ partitionEnum d s 1 := by
    apply partitionEnum_complete
    · simpa only [Multiset.length_sort] using hX.1
    · rw [← Multiset.sum_coe, he]; exact hX.2.2
    · intro x hx
      exact hX.2.1 x ((Multiset.mem_sort (· ≤ ·)).mp hx)
    · exact Multiset.pairwise_sort X (· ≤ ·)
  have hmap := List.mem_map_of_mem (f := fun L : List ℕ => (L : Multiset ℕ)) hm
  rw [he] at hmap
  exact hmap

theorem sort_mem_partitionEnum {d s : ℕ} {X : Multiset ℕ} (hX : IsPartition d s X) :
    X.sort (· ≤ ·) ∈ partitionEnum d s 1 := by
  apply partitionEnum_complete
  · simpa only [Multiset.length_sort] using hX.1
  · rw [← Multiset.sum_coe, Multiset.sort_eq]; exact hX.2.2
  · intro x hx
    exact hX.2.1 x ((Multiset.mem_sort (· ≤ ·)).mp hx)
  · exact Multiset.pairwise_sort X (· ≤ ·)

def ProductFailureCheck (r d s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  let ps := (partitionEnum d s 1).map List.prod
  ∀ p ∈ ps, ps.count p < r

instance (r d s : ℕ) : Decidable (ProductFailureCheck r d s) := by
  unfold ProductFailureCheck
  infer_instance

theorem not_good_of_product_failure {r d s : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : ProductFailureCheck r d s) : ¬ Good r d s := by
  classical
  intro hg
  obtain ⟨p,F,hc,hF⟩ := hg
  let f : Multiset ℕ → List ℕ := fun X => X.sort (· ≤ ·)
  have hinj : Function.Injective f := by
    intro X Y he
    have := congrArg (fun L : List ℕ => (L : Multiset ℕ)) he
    simpa [f] using this
  let L := (partitionEnum d s 1).filter (fun A => A.prod == p)
  have hsub : F.image f ⊆ L.toFinset := by
    intro A hA
    obtain ⟨X,hX,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hA
    apply List.mem_toFinset.mpr
    apply List.mem_filter.mpr
    refine ⟨sort_mem_partitionEnum (hF X hX).1, ?_⟩
    have he : (f X).prod = p := by
      rw [← Multiset.prod_coe, Multiset.sort_eq]
      exact (hF X hX).2
    simpa using he
  have hbound := (Finset.card_le_card hsub).trans (List.toFinset_card_le L)
  rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective F hinj] at hbound
  have hne : F.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨X,hX⟩ := hne
  have hprod : p ∈ (partitionEnum d s 1).map List.prod := by
    have he : (f X).prod = p := by
      rw [← Multiset.prod_coe, Multiset.sort_eq]
      exact (hF X hX).2
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨f X, sort_mem_partitionEnum (hF X hX).1, he⟩
  have hlt := h p hprod
  have hlen : L.length = ((partitionEnum d s 1).map List.prod).count p := by
    simp only [L, List.count_eq_length_filter, List.filter_map, List.length_map, Function.comp_def]
  omega

/-- The complete finite set; used for small sanity cases, not large certificates. -/
def allPartitions (d s : ℕ) : Finset (Multiset ℕ) :=
  ((partitionEnum d s 1).map (fun L : List ℕ => (L : Multiset ℕ))).toFinset

def FailureCheck (r d s : ℕ) : Prop :=
  ∀ X ∈ allPartitions d s,
    ((allPartitions d s).filter (fun Y => Y.prod = X.prod)).card < r

instance (r d s : ℕ) : Decidable (FailureCheck r d s) := by
  unfold FailureCheck
  infer_instance

theorem not_good_of_failure {r d s : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : FailureCheck r d s) : ¬ Good r d s := by
  intro hg
  obtain ⟨p, F, hc, hF⟩ := hg
  have hne : F.Nonempty := Finset.card_pos.mp (by omega)
  obtain ⟨X, hX⟩ := hne
  have hmem : X ∈ allPartitions d s := by
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr (partitionEnum_complete_multiset (hF X hX).1)
  have hsub : F ⊆ (allPartitions d s).filter (fun Y => Y.prod = X.prod) := by
    intro Y hY
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr
      ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr (partitionEnum_complete_multiset (hF Y hY).1),
        (hF Y hY).2.trans (hF X hX).2.symm⟩
  have hle := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  have hlt := h X hmem
  omega

instance (d s : ℕ) (X : Multiset ℕ) : Decidable (IsPartition d s X) := by
  unfold IsPartition
  infer_instance

/-- Positive certificates consist of actual distinct source multisets. -/
def Witness (r d s p : ℕ) (F : List (Multiset ℕ)) : Prop :=
  r ≤ F.length ∧ F.Nodup ∧ ∀ X ∈ F, IsPartition d s X ∧ X.prod = p

instance (r d s p : ℕ) (F : List (Multiset ℕ)) : Decidable (Witness r d s p F) := by
  unfold Witness
  infer_instance

theorem good_of_witness {r d s p : ℕ} {F : List (Multiset ℕ)}
    (h : Witness r d s p F) : Good r d s := by
  refine ⟨p, F.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup h.2.1] using h.1
  · intro X hX
    exact h.2.2 X (List.mem_toFinset.mp hX)

#print axioms partitionEnum_complete_multiset
#print axioms not_good_of_failure
#print axioms good_of_witness
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductStructural.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductDefinitions
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Image
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Multiset.Basic

set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false

namespace EqualProduct

theorem card_mul_le_sum {X : Multiset ℕ} {b : ℕ}
    (hb : ∀ x ∈ X, b ≤ x) : X.card * b ≤ X.sum := by
  induction X using Multiset.induction_on with
  | empty => simp
  | @cons a X ih =>
    have ha := hb a (Multiset.mem_cons_self a X)
    have hX := ih (fun x hx => hb x (Multiset.mem_cons_of_mem hx))
    simp only [Multiset.card_cons, Multiset.sum_cons, Nat.add_mul, Nat.one_mul]
    omega

theorem partition_sum_ge_card {n s : ℕ} {X : Multiset ℕ}
    (hX : IsPartition n s X) : n ≤ s := by
  have := card_mul_le_sum (b := 1) (fun x hx => hX.2.1 x hx)
  simpa [hX.1, hX.2.2] using this

theorem partition_one_mem {n s : ℕ} {X : Multiset ℕ}
    (hX : IsPartition n s X) (hs : s < 2*n) : 1 ∈ X := by
  by_contra h1
  have hbound : ∀ x ∈ X, 2 ≤ x := by
    intro x hx
    have hp := hX.2.1 x hx
    have hn : x ≠ 1 := fun he => h1 (he ▸ hx)
    omega
  have := card_mul_le_sum hbound
  rw [hX.1, hX.2.2] at this
  omega

theorem partition_cons {n s u : ℕ} {X : Multiset ℕ}
    (hX : IsPartition n s X) (hu : 0 < u) :
    IsPartition (n+1) (s+u) (u ::ₘ X) := by
  refine ⟨by simp [hX.1], ?_, by simp [hX.2.2, Nat.add_comm]⟩
  intro x hx
  rcases Multiset.mem_cons.mp hx with h | h
  · simpa [h] using hu
  · exact hX.2.1 x h

theorem partition_erase_one {n s : ℕ} {X : Multiset ℕ}
    (hX : IsPartition n s X) (h1 : 1 ∈ X) :
    IsPartition (n-1) (s-1) (X.erase 1) := by
  refine ⟨by simp only [Multiset.card_erase_of_mem h1, hX.1, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one], ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    exact hX.2.1 x (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hx)
  · have he := Multiset.sum_erase h1
    rw [hX.2.2] at he
    omega

theorem good_mono {r r' n s : ℕ} (h : Good r n s) (hr : r' ≤ r) :
    Good r' n s := by
  obtain ⟨p, F, hc, hF⟩ := h
  exact ⟨p, F, hr.trans hc, hF⟩

theorem good_append {r n t u : ℕ} (h : Good r n t) (hu : 0 < u) :
    Good r (n+1) (t+u) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, F, hc, hF⟩ := h
  refine ⟨u*p, F.image (fun X => u ::ₘ X), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective F (fun _ _ h => (Multiset.cons_inj_right u).mp h)]
    exact hc
  · intro Y hY
    obtain ⟨X, hX, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hY
    exact ⟨partition_cons (hF X hX).1 hu, by simp [(hF X hX).2]⟩

theorem good_append_tail {r n t : ℕ} (h : Good r n t) :
    IsTail r (n+1) (t+1) := by
  refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  have := good_append h (u := s-t) (by omega)
  convert this using 1 <;> omega

theorem good_remove_one {r n s : ℕ} (hs : s < 2*n)
    (h : Good r n s) : Good r (n-1) (s-1) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨p, F, hc, hF⟩ := h
  have hone : ∀ X ∈ F, 1 ∈ X := fun X hX => partition_one_mem (hF X hX).1 hs
  refine ⟨p, F.image (fun X => X.erase 1), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_image_iff.mpr]
    · exact hc
    · intro X hX Y hY hXY
      have he := congrArg (fun Z => (1 : ℕ) ::ₘ Z) hXY
      simpa [Multiset.cons_erase (hone X hX), Multiset.cons_erase (hone Y hY)] using he
  · intro Y hY
    obtain ⟨X, hX, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hY
    refine ⟨partition_erase_one (hF X hX).1 (hone X hX), ?_⟩
    have he := Multiset.prod_erase (hone X hX)
    simpa [(hF X hX).2] using he

theorem good_iff_remove_one {r n s : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    (hs₀ : n ≤ s) (hs : s < 2*n) :
    Good r n s ↔ Good r (n-1) (s-1) := by
  constructor
  · exact good_remove_one hs
  · intro h
    have := good_append h (u := 1) (by decide)
    convert this using 1 <;> omega

#print axioms good_iff_remove_one
#print axioms good_append_tail
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductThresholds.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductStructural
import Mathlib.Data.Multiset.Replicate
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Find

set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false
namespace EqualProduct

theorem partition_sum_card_unique {n : ℕ} {X : Multiset ℕ}
    (hX : IsPartition n n X) : X = Multiset.replicate n 1 := by
  classical
  rw [Multiset.eq_replicate]
  refine ⟨hX.1, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hp := hX.2.1 x hx
  have hb := card_mul_le_sum (X := X.erase x) (b := 1)
    (fun y hy => hX.2.1 y (Multiset.mem_of_mem_erase hy))
  have he := Multiset.sum_erase hx
  have hc := Multiset.card_erase_of_mem hx
  rw [hX.1] at hc
  rw [hX.2.2] at he
  simp only [Nat.mul_one] at hb
  rw [hc, Nat.pred_eq_sub_one] at hb
  omega

theorem not_good_sum_card {r n : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) : ¬ Good r n n := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨p, F, hc, hF⟩ := h
  have hsmall : F.card ≤ 1 := Finset.card_le_one.mpr (by
    intro X hX Y hY
    rw [partition_sum_card_unique (hF X hX).1,
      partition_sum_card_unique (hF Y hY).1])
  omega

theorem tail_has_least {r n U : ℕ} (hU : IsTail r n U) :
    ∃ h, IsSStar r n h ∧ h ≤ U := by
  classical
  have hex : ∃ h, IsTail r n h := ⟨U, hU⟩
  exact ⟨Nat.find hex, ⟨Nat.find_spec hex, fun _ h => Nat.find_min' hex h⟩,
    Nat.find_min' hex hU⟩

theorem sStar_previous_fails {r n h : ℕ} (hh : IsSStar r n h) (hh₀ : 1 < h) :
    ¬ Good r n (h-1) := by
  intro hg
  have ht : IsTail r n (h-1) := by
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    by_cases he : s = h-1
    · simpa [he] using hg
    · exact hh.1.2 s (by omega)
  have := hh.2 (h-1) ht
  omega

theorem sStar_successor {r n h : ℕ} (_hr : 2 ≤ r) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (hh : IsSStar r (n-1) h) (hlo : n ≤ h) (hhi : h < 2*n) :
    IsSStar r n (h+1) := by
  have hf : ¬ Good r n h := by
    intro hg
    exact sStar_previous_fails hh (by omega) (good_remove_one hhi hg)
  have ht : IsTail r n (h+1) := by
    refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    have hgood := good_append (hh.1.2 (s-1) (by omega)) (u := 1) (by decide)
    convert hgood using 1 <;> omega
  refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
  intro h' hh'
  by_contra hbad
  have := hh'.2 h (by omega)
  exact hf this

theorem stability {r n t : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (ht : t ≤ 2*n-4) (hw : Good r (n-2) t) :
    ∃ h, IsSStar r (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar r n (h+1) := by
  have htail := good_append_tail hw
  have he : n-2+1 = n-1 := by omega
  rw [he] at htail
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hbound⟩ := tail_has_least htail
  have hlo : n ≤ h := by
    by_contra hbad
    exact not_good_sum_card hr (hh.1.2 (n-1) (by omega))
  exact ⟨h, hh, sStar_successor hr (by omega) hh hlo (by omega)⟩

theorem threshold_certificate {r d h U : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h) (_hU : h ≤ U)
    (hfail : ¬ Good r d (h-1))
    (hmid : ∀ s, h ≤ s → s < U → Good r d s)
    (htail : Good r (d-1) (U-1)) (hd : 0 < d) (hU₀ : 0 < U) :
    IsSStar r d h := by
  have hpermanent := good_append_tail htail
  have he₁ : d-1+1 = d := by omega
  have he₂ : U-1+1 = U := by omega
  rw [he₁, he₂] at hpermanent
  refine ⟨⟨hh, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · intro s hs
    by_cases hlt : s < U
    · exact hmid s hs hlt
    · exact hpermanent.2 s (by omega)
  · intro h' hh'
    by_contra hbad
    exact hfail (hh'.2 (h-1) (by omega))

#print axioms stability
#print axioms threshold_certificate
#print axioms sStar_successor
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductFamilies.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductThresholds
import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Prod
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Multiset.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

set_option linter.unnecessarySeqFocus false
namespace EqualProduct

def pad (d : ℕ) (X : Multiset ℕ) : Multiset ℕ :=
  X + Multiset.replicate (d-X.card) 1

theorem pad_partition {d t : ℕ} {X : Multiset ℕ} (hc : X.card ≤ d)
    (hp : ∀ x ∈ X, 0 < x) (hs : X.sum = X.card + t) :
    IsPartition d (d+t) (pad d X) := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [pad, Multiset.card_add, Multiset.card_replicate]
    omega
  · intro x hx
    rcases Multiset.mem_add.mp hx with hx | hx
    · exact hp x hx
    · have he := Multiset.eq_of_mem_replicate hx
      omega
  · simp only [pad, Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_replicate, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_id,
      Nat.mul_one, hs]
    omega

@[simp] theorem pad_prod (d : ℕ) (X : Multiset ℕ) : (pad d X).prod = X.prod := by
  simp [pad]

def block (m q u v w : ℕ) : Multiset ℕ :=
  Multiset.replicate (5*u+3*v+2*w+q) 2 +
  Multiset.replicate (m-v) 3 +
  Multiset.replicate (4*(m-u)+2*(m-v)) 4 +
  Multiset.replicate (2*(m-w)+v) 6 +
  Multiset.replicate u 8 + Multiset.replicate w 9

theorem block_card {m q u v w : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ m) (hv : v ≤ m) (hw : w ≤ m) :
    (block m q u v w).card = 9*m+2*u+v+w+q := by
  simp only [block, Multiset.card_add, Multiset.card_replicate]
  omega

theorem block_surplus {m q u v w : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ m) (hv : v ≤ m) (hw : w ≤ m) :
    (block m q u v w).sum = (block m q u v w).card + (30*m+q) := by
  rw [block_card hu hv hw]
  simp only [block, Multiset.sum_add, Multiset.sum_replicate, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_id]
  omega

theorem block_card_le {m q u v w : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ m) (hv : v ≤ m) (hw : w ≤ m) :
    (block m q u v w).card ≤ 30*m+q := by
  rw [block_card hu hv hw]
  omega

theorem block_positive (m q u v w : ℕ) : ∀ x ∈ block m q u v w, 0 < x := by
  intro x hx
  simp only [block, Multiset.mem_add, Multiset.mem_replicate] at hx
  rcases hx with (((((⟨_, rfl⟩ | ⟨_, rfl⟩) | ⟨_, rfl⟩) | ⟨_, rfl⟩) | ⟨_, rfl⟩) | ⟨_, rfl⟩) <;>
    decide

theorem product_factorization (a b c d e f : ℕ) :
    2^a * 3^b * 4^c * 6^d * 8^e * 9^f =
      2^(a+2*c+d+3*e) * 3^(b+d+2*f) := by
  have h4 : (4 : ℕ) = 2^2 := by decide
  have h6 : (6 : ℕ) = 2*3 := by decide
  have h8 : (8 : ℕ) = 2^3 := by decide
  have h9 : (9 : ℕ) = 3^2 := by decide
  rw [h4, h6, h8, h9]
  simp only [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, pow_add]
  ring

theorem block_prod {m q u v w : ℕ} (hu : u ≤ m) (hv : v ≤ m) (hw : w ≤ m) :
    (block m q u v w).prod = 2^(14*m+q) * 3^(3*m) := by
  simp only [block, Multiset.prod_add, Multiset.prod_replicate]
  rw [product_factorization]
  congr 2 <;> omega

@[simp] theorem pad_block_count8 (d m q u v w : ℕ) :
    (pad d (block m q u v w)).count 8 = u := by simp [pad, block, Multiset.count_replicate]

@[simp] theorem pad_block_count9 (d m q u v w : ℕ) :
    (pad d (block m q u v w)).count 9 = w := by simp [pad, block, Multiset.count_replicate]

@[simp] theorem pad_block_count3 (d m q u v w : ℕ) :
    (pad d (block m q u v w)).count 3 = m-v := by simp [pad, block, Multiset.count_replicate]

theorem block_injective {d m q u v w u' v' w' : ℕ} (hv : v ≤ m) (hv' : v' ≤ m)
    (h : pad d (block m q u v w) = pad d (block m q u' v' w')) :
    u = u' ∧ v = v' ∧ w = w' := by
  have h8 := congrArg (Multiset.count 8) h
  have h9 := congrArg (Multiset.count 9) h
  have h3 := congrArg (Multiset.count 3) h
  simp only [pad_block_count8, pad_block_count9, pad_block_count3] at *
  omega

theorem cubic_bound {m q : ℕ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hq : q < 30) :
    30*m+q+2 ≤ (m+1)^3 := by
  have hnon : 0 ≤ (m-5)^3 + 18*(m-5)^2 + 78*(m-5) + 35 := Nat.zero_le _
  have he : m = (m-5)+5 := by omega
  rw [he]
  nlinarith

def tripleRange (m : ℕ) : Finset (ℕ × ℕ × ℕ) :=
  (Finset.range (m+1)) ×ˢ ((Finset.range (m+1)) ×ˢ (Finset.range (m+1)))

theorem tripleRange_mem {m u v w : ℕ} :
    (u,v,w) ∈ tripleRange m ↔ u ≤ m ∧ v ≤ m ∧ w ≤ m := by
  simp only [tripleRange, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
  omega

theorem tripleRange_card (m : ℕ) : (tripleRange m).card = (m+1)^3 := by
  simp [tripleRange, Finset.card_product, pow_succ, Nat.mul_assoc]

theorem cubic_family {m q : ℕ} (hm : 5 ≤ m) (hq : q < 30) :
    Good (30*m+q+2) (30*m+q) (2*(30*m+q)) := by
  classical
  let f : ℕ × ℕ × ℕ → Multiset ℕ := fun z =>
    pad (30*m+q) (block m q z.1 z.2.1 z.2.2)
  refine ⟨2^(14*m+q)*3^(3*m), (tripleRange m).image f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hinj : Set.InjOn f (tripleRange m) := by
      intro ⟨u,v,w⟩ hz ⟨u',v',w'⟩ hz' he
      have hz := tripleRange_mem.mp hz
      have hz' := tripleRange_mem.mp hz'
      have he := block_injective hz.2.1 hz'.2.1 he
      simp only [Prod.mk.injEq]
      exact ⟨he.1, he.2⟩
    rw [Finset.card_image_iff.mpr hinj, tripleRange_card]
    exact cubic_bound hm hq
  · intro X hX
    obtain ⟨⟨u,v,w⟩, hz, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hX
    obtain ⟨hu,hv,hw⟩ := tripleRange_mem.mp hz
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have hp := pad_partition (block_card_le hu hv hw) (block_positive m q u v w)
        (block_surplus hu hv hw)
      convert hp using 1 <;> omega
    · exact (pad_prod _ _).trans (block_prod hu hv hw)

theorem large_family {n : ℕ} (hn : 152 ≤ n) : Good n (n-2) (2*n-4) := by
  let m := (n-2)/30
  let q := (n-2)%30
  have hq : q < 30 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  have he : 30*m+q = n-2 := by
    dsimp [m, q]
    omega
  have hm : 5 ≤ m := by dsimp [m]; omega
  have hg := cubic_family hm hq
  convert hg using 1 <;> omega

theorem large_successor {r n : ℕ} (hn : 152 ≤ n) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hrn : r ≤ n) :
    ∃ h, IsSStar r (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar r n (h+1) :=
  stability hr (by omega) (by omega) (good_mono (large_family hn) hrn)

#print axioms large_family
#print axioms large_successor
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductBridge.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductFinite
import EqualProductFamilies
import Mathlib.Data.List.Lex

namespace EqualProduct

theorem good_pad_ones {r d s : ℕ} (h : Good r d s) (k : ℕ) :
    Good r (d+k) (s+k) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simpa using h
  | succ k ih =>
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using good_append ih (u := 1) (by decide)

/-- Small positive certificate; the input lists contain only non-one parts. -/
def NononeWitness (r d T p : ℕ) (As : List (List ℕ)) : Prop :=
  r ≤ As.length ∧ As.Nodup ∧ ∀ A ∈ As,
    A.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) ∧ A.length ≤ d ∧ (∀ a ∈ A, 2 ≤ a) ∧
    A.sum = A.length + T ∧ A.prod = p

instance (r d T p : ℕ) (As : List (List ℕ)) :
    Decidable (NononeWitness r d T p As) := by
  unfold NononeWitness
  infer_instance

theorem pad_filter {d : ℕ} {A : List ℕ} (hA : ∀ a ∈ A, 2 ≤ a) :
    (pad d (A : Multiset ℕ)).filter (· ≠ 1) = (A : Multiset ℕ) := by
  rw [pad, Multiset.filter_add]
  have h₁ : (A : Multiset ℕ).filter (· ≠ 1) = (A : Multiset ℕ) := by
    apply Multiset.filter_eq_self.mpr
    intro a ha
    have := hA a (Multiset.mem_coe.mp ha)
    omega
  rw [h₁]
  simp [Multiset.mem_replicate]

theorem good_of_nonone_witness {r d T p : ℕ} {As : List (List ℕ)}
    (h : NononeWitness r d T p As) : Good r d (d+T) := by
  classical
  let f : List ℕ → Multiset ℕ := fun A => pad d (A : Multiset ℕ)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn f As.toFinset := by
    intro A hA B hB he
    have hA := h.2.2 A (List.mem_toFinset.mp hA)
    have hB := h.2.2 B (List.mem_toFinset.mp hB)
    have hf := congrArg (Multiset.filter (· ≠ 1)) he
    change (pad d (A : Multiset ℕ)).filter _ = (pad d (B : Multiset ℕ)).filter _ at hf
    rw [pad_filter hA.2.2.1, pad_filter hB.2.2.1] at hf
    exact (Multiset.coe_eq_coe.mp hf).eq_of_pairwise' hA.1 hB.1
  refine ⟨p, As.toFinset.image f, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Finset.card_image_iff.mpr hinj, List.toFinset_card_of_nodup h.2.1]
    exact h.1
  · intro X hX
    obtain ⟨A,hA,rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hX
    have hA := h.2.2 A (List.mem_toFinset.mp hA)
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · apply pad_partition
      · simpa using hA.2.1
      · intro a ha
        have := hA.2.2.1 a (Multiset.mem_coe.mp ha)
        omega
      · simpa only [Multiset.sum_coe, Multiset.coe_card] using hA.2.2.2.1
    · exact (pad_prod _ _).trans (by simpa using hA.2.2.2.2)

#print axioms good_of_nonone_witness
end EqualProduct
```

```lean
theorem bridge_family {n : ℕ} (hn : 38 ≤ n) (hn' : n < 152) :
    ∃ t, t ≤ 2*n-4 ∧ Good n (n-2) t := by
  by_cases h38 : n ≤ 38 
  ·

    have hr : n ≤ 38 := h38
    have he : 36+(n-38) = n-2 := by omega
    rw [he] at hg

  by_cases h39 : n ≤ 40

    have hr : n ≤ 40 := h39
    have he : 37+(n-39) = n-2 := by omega
    rw [he] at hg

  by_cases h41 : n ≤ 51

    rw [he] at hg

  by_cases h52 : n ≤ 140 
  ·

    rw [he] at hg

  have h141 : n ≤ 151 := by omega

  have he : 139+(n-141) = n-2 := by omega
  rw [he] at hg
  exact ⟨199+(n-141), by omega, good_mono hg hr⟩

  · exact large_successor hlarge hr hrn

    exact stability hr (by omega) ht (good_mono hg hrn)
```

### `EqualProductPrototype.lean`

```lean
import Mathlib.Data.List.Sort

set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false

namespace EqualProduct

/-- Products of sorted non-one parts with given surplus, with a structural fuel. -/
def productEnum : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ
  | 0, _, t, _ => if t = 0 then [1] else []
  | fuel+1, d, t, b =>
    if t = 0 then [1]
    else if d = 0 then []
    else if t < b then []
    else [t+1] ++ (List.range' b (t/2+1-b)).flatMap fun x =>
      (productEnum fuel (d-1) (t-x) x).map (fun p => (x+1)*p)

/-- Maximum length of a constant run in a sorted product list. -/
def maxRunAux : List ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → ℕ
  | [], _, run, best => max run best
  | x::xs, prev, run, best =>
    if x = prev then maxRunAux xs x (run+1) best
    else maxRunAux xs x 1 (max best run)

def maxRun (L : List ℕ) : ℕ := maxRunAux L 0 0 0

def maxMultiplicity (d t : ℕ) : ℕ :=
  maxRun ((productEnum t d t 1).mergeSort (· ≤ ·))

set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 0

theorem maxRunAux_ge (L : List ℕ) (prev run best : ℕ) :
    run ≤ maxRunAux L prev run best ∧ best ≤ maxRunAux L prev run best := by
  induction L generalizing prev run best with
  | nil => simp [maxRunAux]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    by_cases he : x = prev
    · simp only [maxRunAux, ite_eq_left he]
      have := ih x (run+1) best
      omega
    · simp only [maxRunAux, ite_eq_right he]
      have := ih x 1 (max best run)
      omega

theorem count_le_maxRunAux {L : List ℕ} (hord : L.Pairwise (· ≤ ·))
    (prev run best p : ℕ) (hlo : ∀ x ∈ L, prev ≤ x) :
    L.count p + (if p = prev then run else 0) ≤ maxRunAux L prev run best := by
  induction L generalizing prev run best with
  | nil =>
    simp only [List.count_nil, Nat.zero_add, maxRunAux]
    split <;> omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    have hsort := List.pairwise_cons.mp hord
    have hl := hlo x (by simp)
    by_cases he : x = prev
    · simp only [maxRunAux, ite_eq_left he]
      have ht := ih hsort.2 x (run+1) best hsort.1
      by_cases hp : p = x
      · subst p
        simp [List.count_cons, he] at *
        omega
      · have hpv : p ≠ prev := by omega
        simpa [List.count_cons, hp, hpv, Ne.symm hpv, he] using ht
    · by_cases hp : p = prev
      · subst p
        have hnot : prev ∉ x::xs := by
          intro hh
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hh with hh | hh
          · omega
          · have := hsort.1 prev hh
            omega
        have hz : (x::xs).count prev = 0 := List.count_eq_zero.mpr hnot
        simp only [hz, ite_eq_left rfl, Nat.zero_add]
        exact (maxRunAux_ge (x::xs) prev run best).1
      · simp only [maxRunAux, ite_eq_right he, ite_eq_right hp, Nat.add_zero]
        have ht := ih hsort.2 x 1 (max best run) hsort.1
        by_cases hx : p = x
        · subst p
          simpa [List.count_cons] using ht
        · simp [List.count_cons, hx, Ne.symm hx] at *
          exact ht

theorem count_le_maxRun {L : List ℕ} (hord : L.Pairwise (· ≤ ·)) (p : ℕ) :
    L.count p ≤ maxRun L := by
  have := count_le_maxRunAux hord 0 0 0 p (fun x _ => Nat.zero_le x)
  simpa [maxRun] using this

theorem count_le_sorted_maxRun (L : List ℕ) (p : ℕ) :
    L.count p ≤ maxRun (L.mergeSort (· ≤ ·)) := by
  have hp := (List.mergeSort_perm L (· ≤ ·)).count_eq p
  rw [← hp]
  exact count_le_maxRun (List.pairwise_mergeSort' (· ≤ ·) L) p

#print axioms count_le_sorted_maxRun
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductProducts.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductFinite
import EqualProductPrototype

namespace EqualProduct

/-- Product projection of the verified fixed-length canonical enumerator. -/
def fixedProducts : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ → List ℕ
  | 0, s, _ => if s = 0 then [1] else []
  | d+1, s, b => (List.range' b (s/(d+1)+1-b)).flatMap fun a =>
      (fixedProducts d (s-a) a).map (fun p => a*p)

theorem map_prod_partitionEnum (d s b : ℕ) :
    (partitionEnum d s b).map List.prod = fixedProducts d s b := by
  induction d generalizing s b with
  | zero => by_cases hs : s = 0 <;> simp [partitionEnum, fixedProducts, hs]
  | succ d ih =>
    simp only [partitionEnum, fixedProducts, List.map_flatMap, List.map_map]
    congr 1
    funext a
    rw [← ih]
    simp only [List.map_map, Function.comp_def, List.prod_cons]

theorem not_good_of_sorted_failure {r d s : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : maxRun ((fixedProducts d s 1).mergeSort (· ≤ ·)) < r) :
    ¬ Good r d s := by
  apply not_good_of_product_failure hr
  dsimp only [ProductFailureCheck]
  rw [map_prod_partitionEnum]
  intro p _
  exact (count_le_sorted_maxRun _ p).trans_lt h

#print axioms map_prod_partitionEnum
#print axioms not_good_of_sorted_failure
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductKernelSort.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductProducts

namespace EqualProduct

/-- Fuel makes both branches of merging reduce structurally in the kernel. -/
def kernelMerge : ℕ → List ℕ → List ℕ → List ℕ
  | 0, L, R => L ++ R
  | _+1, [], R => R
  | _+1, L, [] => L
  | k+1, a::L, b::R => if a ≤ b then a :: kernelMerge k L (b::R)
      else b :: kernelMerge k (a::L) R

theorem kernelMerge_eq (k : ℕ) (L R : List ℕ) (hk : L.length + R.length ≤ k) :
    kernelMerge k L R = L.merge R (· ≤ ·) := by
  induction k generalizing L R with
  | zero =>
    have hL : L = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega)
    have hR : R = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by omega)
    simp [hL,hR,kernelMerge]
  | succ k ih =>
    cases L with
    | nil => simp [kernelMerge]
    | cons a L =>
      cases R with
      | nil => simp [kernelMerge]
      | cons b R =>
        simp only [kernelMerge, List.merge]
        by_cases h : a ≤ b
        · simp only [h, decide_true, ite_true]
          congr 1
          apply ih
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hk ⊢
          omega
        · simp only [h, decide_false, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false]
          congr 1
          apply ih
          simp only [List.length_cons] at hk ⊢
          omega

/-- Balanced structural sorting; insertion sort is a safe fallback at fuel zero. -/
def kernelSort : ℕ → List ℕ → List ℕ
  | 0, L => L.insertionSort (· ≤ ·)
  | _+1, [] => []
  | _+1, [a] => [a]
  | k+1, a::b::L =>
    let A := (a::b::L).take ((L.length+3)/2)
    let B := (a::b::L).drop ((L.length+3)/2)
    kernelMerge (A.length+B.length) (kernelSort k A) (kernelSort k B)

theorem kernelSort_perm (k : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) : List.Perm (kernelSort k L) L := by
  induction k generalizing L with
  | zero => exact List.perm_insertionSort (· ≤ ·) L
  | succ k ih =>
    cases L with
    | nil => simp [kernelSort]
    | cons a L =>
      cases L with
      | nil => simp [kernelSort]
      | cons b L =>
        simp only [kernelSort]
        rw [kernelMerge_eq]
        · exact List.Perm.trans (List.merge_perm_append _)
            (((ih _).append (ih _)).trans (by rw [List.take_append_drop]))
        · rw [(ih _).length_eq, (ih _).length_eq]

theorem kernelSort_pairwise (k : ℕ) (L : List ℕ) :
    (kernelSort k L).Pairwise (· ≤ ·) := by
  induction k generalizing L with
  | zero => exact List.pairwise_insertionSort (· ≤ ·) L
  | succ k ih =>
    cases L with
    | nil => simp [kernelSort]
    | cons a L =>
      cases L with
      | nil => simp [kernelSort]
      | cons b L =>
        simp only [kernelSort]
        rw [kernelMerge_eq]
        · exact List.Pairwise.merge (ih _) (ih _)
        · rw [(kernelSort_perm k _).length_eq, (kernelSort_perm k _).length_eq]

theorem not_good_of_kernel_failure {r d s : ℕ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (h : maxRun (kernelSort 16 (fixedProducts d s 1)) < r) : ¬ Good r d s := by
  apply not_good_of_product_failure hr
  dsimp only [ProductFailureCheck]
  rw [map_prod_partitionEnum]
  intro p _
  have hc := (kernelSort_perm 16 (fixedProducts d s 1)).count_eq p
  have hb := count_le_maxRun (kernelSort_pairwise 16 (fixedProducts d s 1)) p
  rw [hc] at hb
  exact hb.trans_lt h

#print axioms not_good_of_kernel_failure
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductCertificate.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductKernelSort
import EqualProductBridge

namespace EqualProduct

/-- A streaming merge certificate. Recursion consumes the supplied output. -/
def mergeCheck : List ℕ → List ℕ → List ℕ → Bool
  | [], [], [] => true
  | _, _, [] => false
  | [], b::R, c::O => (b == c) && mergeCheck [] R O
  | a::L, [], c::O => (a == c) && mergeCheck L [] O
  | [], [], _::_ => false
  | a::L, b::R, c::O =>
      if a ≤ b then (a == c) && mergeCheck L (b::R) O
      else (b == c) && mergeCheck (a::L) R O

theorem mergeCheck_sound {L R O : List ℕ} (h : mergeCheck L R O = true) :
    O.Perm (L ++ R) := by
  induction O generalizing L R with
  | nil =>
    cases L <;> cases R <;> simp_all [mergeCheck]
  | cons c O ih =>
    cases L with
    | nil =>
      cases R with
      | nil => simp [mergeCheck] at h
      | cons b R =>
        simp only [mergeCheck, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl,h⟩ := h
        simpa using (ih h).cons b
    | cons a L =>
      cases R with
      | nil =>
        simp only [mergeCheck, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
        obtain ⟨rfl,h⟩ := h
        simpa using (ih h).cons a
      | cons b R =>
        by_cases hab : a ≤ b
        · simp only [mergeCheck, ite_eq_left hab, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
          obtain ⟨rfl,h⟩ := h
          exact (ih h).cons a
        · simp only [mergeCheck, ite_eq_right hab, Bool.and_eq_true, beq_iff_eq] at h
          obtain ⟨rfl,h⟩ := h
          exact ((ih h).cons b).trans (List.perm_middle.symm)

/-- Linear sortedness test, avoiding the quadratic Pairwise decision. -/
def ordered : List ℕ → Bool
  | [] => true
  | [_] => true
  | a::b::L => decide (a ≤ b) && ordered (b::L)

theorem ordered_sound {L : List ℕ} (h : ordered L = true) : L.Pairwise (· ≤ ·) := by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a L ih =>
    cases L with
    | nil => simp
    | cons b L =>
      have hh : a ≤ b ∧ ordered (b::L) = true := by simpa [ordered] using h
      have ht := ih hh.2
      apply List.pairwise_cons.mpr
      refine ⟨?_, ht⟩
      intro c hc
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hc with rfl | hc
      · exact hh.1
      · exact hh.1.trans ((List.pairwise_cons.mp ht).1 c hc)

/-- Explicit sorted data may overcount partitions; permutation certificates suffice. -/
theorem not_good_of_certificate {r d s : ℕ} {O : List ℕ}
    (hr : 0 < r) (hp : O.Perm (fixedProducts d s 1))
    (ho : ordered O = true) (hm : maxRun O < r) : ¬ Good r d s := by
  apply not_good_of_product_failure hr
  dsimp only [ProductFailureCheck]
  rw [map_prod_partitionEnum]
  intro p _
  have hb := count_le_maxRun (ordered_sound ho) p
  rw [hp.count_eq p] at hb
  exact hb.trans_lt hm

/-- Padding transfers a single negative certificate to every smaller dimension
at the same surplus, and to every larger required multiplicity. -/
theorem not_good_of_padding {r R d D t : ℕ} (hr : R ≤ r) (hd : d ≤ D)
    (h : ¬ Good R D (D+t)) : ¬ Good r d (d+t) := by
  intro hg
  have hh := good_pad_ones (good_mono hg hr) (D-d)
  apply h
  convert hh using 1 <;> omega

#print axioms not_good_of_certificate
#print axioms not_good_of_padding
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductTails.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductPositive01

namespace EqualProduct

/-- Positive interval witnesses and one lower-dimensional witness give a tail. -/
theorem tail_certificate {r d h U : ℕ} (hh : 0 < h)
    (hmid : ∀ s, h ≤ s → s < U → Good r d s)
    (htail : Good r (d-1) (U-1)) (hd : 0 < d) (hU : 0 < U) : IsTail r d h := by
  have ht := good_append_tail htail
  have he₁ : d-1+1 = d := by omega
  have he₂ : U-1+1 = U := by omega
  rw [he₁,he₂] at ht
  refine ⟨hh, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  by_cases hlt : s < U
  · exact hmid s hs hlt
  · exact ht.2 s (by omega)

theorem isSStar_of_tail_failure {r d h : ℕ} (ht : IsTail r d h)
    (hf : ¬ Good r d (h-1)) : IsSStar r d h := by
  refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
  intro h' hh'
  by_contra hbad
  exact hf (hh'.2 (h-1) (by omega))

theorem tail_7_9_30 : IsTail 7 9 30 := by
  exact good_append_tail (good_mono (r' := 7) positive_7_8_29 (by decide))
```

### `EqualProductRelaxed.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductThresholds
namespace EqualProduct

/-- The forced-one argument only needs the witness sum at most 2n-2. -/
theorem stability_relaxed {r n t : ℕ} (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hn : 4 ≤ n)
    (ht : t ≤ 2*n-2) (hw : Good r (n-2) t) :
    ∃ h, IsSStar r (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar r n (h+1) := by
  have htail := good_append_tail hw
  have he : n-2+1 = n-1 := by omega
  rw [he] at htail
  obtain ⟨h, hh, hbound⟩ := tail_has_least htail
  have hlo : n ≤ h := by
    by_contra hbad
    exact not_good_sum_card hr (hh.1.2 (n-1) (by omega))
  exact ⟨h, hh, sStar_successor hr (by omega) hh hlo (by omega)⟩

#print axioms stability_relaxed
end EqualProduct
```

### `EqualProductFrom35.lean`

```lean
import EqualProductPartial
import EqualProductRelaxed
import EqualProductPositive14
import EqualProductPositive15
import EqualProductPositive16

namespace EqualProduct

/-- The relaxed stability bound eliminates n=35,36,37 from the exhaustive base. -/
theorem successor_from_35 {r n : ℕ} (hn : 35 ≤ n)
    (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hrn : r ≤ n) :
    ∃ h, IsSStar r (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar r n (h+1) := by
  by_cases h38 : 38 ≤ n
  · exact successor_from_38 h38 hr hrn
  have he : n = 35 ∨ n = 36 ∨ n = 37 := by omega
  rcases he with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact stability_relaxed (n := 35) (t := 68) hr (by decide) (by decide)
      (good_mono positive_35_33_68 hrn)
  · exact stability_relaxed (n := 36) (t := 70) hr (by decide) (by decide)
      (good_mono positive_36_34_70 hrn)
  · exact stability_relaxed (n := 37) (t := 71) hr (by decide) (by decide)
      (good_mono positive_37_35_71 hrn)

theorem conj52a_from35 : ∀ n, 35 ≤ n → ∃ h,
    IsSStar (n-2) (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar (n-2) n (h+1) := by
  intro n hn
  exact successor_from_35 hn (by omega) (by omega)

theorem conj52b_from35 : ∀ n, 35 ≤ n → ∃ h,
    IsSStar (n-1) (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar (n-1) n (h+1) := by
  intro n hn
  exact successor_from_35 hn (by omega) (by omega)

theorem conj52c_from35 : ∀ n, 35 ≤ n → ∃ h,
    IsSStar n (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar n n (h+1) := by
  intro n hn
  exact successor_from_35 hn (by omega) (by omega)

theorem conj52a_from34 : ∀ n, 34 ≤ n → ∃ h,
    IsSStar (n-2) (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar (n-2) n (h+1) := by
  intro n hn
  by_cases h35 : 35 ≤ n
  · exact conj52a_from35 n h35
  · have he : n = 34 := by omega
    subst n
    exact stability_relaxed (r := 32) (n := 34) (t := 66) (by decide) (by decide)
      (by decide) positive_32_32_66

#print axioms conj52a_from34
#print axioms successor_from_35
#print axioms conj52a_from35
#print axioms conj52b_from35
#print axioms conj52c_from35
end EqualProduct
```

```lean
    IsSStar (n-2) (n-1) h ∧ IsSStar (n-2) n (h+1) := by
```
